name: Storybook MCP
description: Gives coding agents your Storybook's component docs, story instructions and test runs through a local MCP addon, for front-end teams that want generated UI to reuse their design system.

skills.name: Component Docs
skills.description: Lists documented components and returns each one's props, example stories and usage notes from your Storybook components manifest.

skills.name: Story Authoring
skills.description: Returns current instructions for writing stories and interaction tests, then previews the new stories in chat or links to them.

skills.name: Run Component Tests
skills.description: Runs tests for specific stories, including accessibility checks when configured, and tells the agent how to resolve the failures.

skills.name: Find Affected Stories
skills.description: Maps component source files to the stories that render them and lists the stories affected by your local file changes.
